theory_name: The Abdul Karim & Misc Case Defense

components.claim: Abdul Karim acquired 349 decimals via Nawab Estate Patta in 1934.
components.evidence_offered: Oral assertion, alleged 1334 BS rent receipt (No. 349).
components.vulnerability: No registered patta, no kabuliyat. Rent receipt is chronologically impossible (numbered higher than a receipt 23 years newer) and does not create title.

components.claim: Sona Bhanu inherited a share and sued in 1st Munsif Court (Misc Case 1181/1969).
components.evidence_offered: None (No decree or certified copy produced).
components.vulnerability: Withholding primary evidence triggers adverse inference under Sec 114(g) Evidence Act.

components.claim: SA Khatian was corrected to include Sona Bhanu based on the Misc Case.
components.evidence_offered: AC Land Volume photocopy showing name in different ink (Exhibit G-1).
components.vulnerability: Margin note in administrative copy cannot override finally published DC Record Room Khatian (Sec 144A presumption). Mutation authority has no jurisdiction to decide title.
